# Google's widget, for comparison

Unmodified copies from [github.com/chronicle/content-hub](https://github.com/chronicle/content-hub), `content/response_integrations/google/wiz/`, fetched 27 Sep 2026 at commit `85d08c2e9591`. Apache-2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)).

- `get_blue_agent_analysis.html` and `.yaml` are the predefined widget for the Get Blue Agent Analysis action.
- `get_blue_agent_analysis_JsonResult_example.json` is the action's example result.

They are here so the harness can run the widget in use today beside the card, on the same result.
